scan.exclusion_rule: Reject both sides of a pair if a Cargo build/test is detected at 500ms intervals. Require a 5s quiet window before each pair.

controls.cold_definition: Empty package store and project state; operating-system file cache is warm.
controls.warm_definition: Reuse the package store, remove project dependency state, and install again.
controls.up_to_date_definition: Run install again without removing project state.

install.confirmation_protocol: The first 20-pair batch flagged disabled cold-install p95 and left enabled cold installs inconclusive. One additional fixed 20-pair batch used the same setup. All 40 pairs are pooled; both original batches remain in attempts.

limitations: Single-machine measurement; background desktop activity and filesystem cache are not fully controlled.
The install fixture has five local archives and does not estimate network-heavy project installs.
Peak RSS measures each whole scanner or installer process.
The source scan uses four Rayon threads and scans packages sequentially.
